data: First landing near the lunar south pole
Skeleton entry for /fleet (PRD-012 v0.2 / Phase A scaffold). Builder + agency + first-flight per public sources. Specs and gallery TBD in later phases.

India’s first successful lunar lander (August 2023), the first spacecraft to land near the lunar south pole. Four years after Vikram CY-2 crashed in the same region — the redemption arc India and ISRO needed.
First soft-landing near the lunar south pole
India's heavy-lift pad — GSLV Mk III / LVM3 to Chandrayaan-3 and the upcoming Gaganyaan crew programme
Lander of India's Chandrayaan-2; it crashed in 2019, but the orbiter kept working
Japan's first private Moon landing attempts; Mission 1 (2023) and Mission 2 (2025) both crashed
First U.S. lunar landing since Apollo; sideways
Pinpoint lunar landing; toppled but operational
First-ever lunar far-side sample return. Apollo basin landing 2024-06-01 (UTC); 1935 g returned to Inner Mongolia 2024-06-25
Blue Origin's first-generation lunar cargo lander — single-stage hydrogen / oxygen vehicle, ~3 t to the surface

First spacecraft to land that close to the lunar south pole, at about 69°S — the most contested territory in current space exploration, where permanently shadowed craters harbour water ice. Pragyan made the first in-situ detection of sulfur near the lunar south pole using its LIBS instrument. India became the fourth nation to soft-land on the Moon.
